    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ChatModel
    A pluggable text-generation backend for RAG.
    DistanceMetric
    A vector distance function.
    EchoChatModel
    A trivial, deterministic ChatModel that echoes the question and the retrieved context instead of calling a real LLM.
    EmbeddingProvider
    Converts text into a vector embedding for storage in a CockroachDB VECTOR column.
    HashingEmbeddingProvider
    A deterministic, dependency-free EmbeddingProvider that hashes whitespace-delimited tokens into a fixed-dimension bag-of-words vector and L2-normalizes the result.
    RagTemplate
    A minimal Retrieval-Augmented Generation helper: retrieve the most similar documents from a VectorStore, then hand their content to a ChatModel to generate a grounded answer.
    VectorDocument
    A document to store in a VectorStore.
    Vectors
    Helpers for CockroachDB's VECTOR literal format.
    VectorSearchResult
    A single hit from a vector similarity search.
    VectorSearchTemplate
    Low-level vector similarity search over an arbitrary CockroachDB table using the native VECTOR operators.
    VectorSearchTemplate.SearchRequest
    A vector search request; build with VectorSearchTemplate.SearchRequest.builder().
    VectorSearchTemplate.SearchRequest.Builder
    Builder for VectorSearchTemplate.SearchRequest.
    VectorStore
    High-level document store backed by CockroachDB's native VECTOR type.
    VectorStoreConfig
    Immutable configuration for a VectorStore: table and column names, distance metric, vector dimensionality, and vector-index options for CockroachDB v26.2+.
    VectorStoreConfig.Builder
    Builder for VectorStoreConfig.
